proposal.raw_text:
BOOKKEEPING PROPOSAL

PROPOSED BY

CARE/OF EXPERIENCES

20 FEB, 2025

SCOPE & SERVICES

Weekly Bookkeeping

• Process all entries in QuickBooks Online (expenses and revenue)

• Record and categorize all bank & credit card transactions (max 5 accounts)

• Project or Customer tracking on all transactions (data provided by Client)

• Oversee Accounts Receivable and Payable functions (managed by Client)

• All entries updated live (within 3 business days of week end)

Monthly Reconciliations

• Monthly reconciliations of Payables, Receivables, Credit card & Bank accounts

• All monthly reconciliations to be completed within 7 business days of receiving previous month’s credit card and bank statements

Expense Management via QuickBooks Online (or email)

• Upload receipts directly to QBO for seamless tracking and reconciliation

• Mobile App support for real-time expense tracking

• Client responsible for uploading receipts either via QBO app or email

Payroll Processing via QuickBooks Online (upto 3 Employees)

• Biweekly payroll payments via direct deposit through QBO

• Includes employee change management

• Calculation and remittance of source deductions (CPP, EI, Fed & Prov tax)

• Annual preparation of T4 slips, reconciliation & government reporting

Monthly Financial Statements and Virtual Monthly Check-ins

• P&L

• Balance sheet

• Cash flow statement

• AR/AP aging report

Sales Tax Compliance and Year-end Closing

• Detailed review of each ledger account & posting of accruals where necessary

• Preparation of financial reports for the tax preparer or auditor

• Coordination with the tax preparer & facilitation of any additional requests

• GST/HST tax filing

• Year-end meeting to review financial results and discuss the upcoming year

FEES

Monthly Fees: $425/month + HST

This package includes:

• Unlimited emails and virtual meetings for inquiries and support

• Ongoing support for bookkeeping, payroll processing, reconciliations, and financial reporting

The following charges are not included in the monthly fee:

• Software subscriptions (QBO): The cost of QuickBooks Online (QBO) must be maintained by the Client

• Bookkeeping backlog: Any prior period bookkeeping clean-up or catch-up work will be quoted separately based on the volume and complexity

MONTHLY ESTIMATED SOFTWARE CHARGES

Columns: First 8 months | Ongoing (without discount) | Ongoing (with Sympl Discount - TBD)

QBO:
First 8 months: $6
Ongoing without discount: $24
Ongoing with Sympl Discount - TBD: $12

QBO Payroll:
First 8 months: $6.25 + $4
Ongoing without discount: $25 + $4
Ongoing with Sympl Discount - TBD: $12.5 + $4

QBO Expense:
First 8 months: $0
Ongoing without discount: $0
Ongoing with Sympl Discount - TBD: $0

TOTAL:
First 8 months: $16.25
Ongoing without discount: $53
Ongoing with Sympl Discount - TBD: $28.5
